# Scientific Writing

## Scope

Draft scientific manuscripts from actual methods and results with traceable claims and reproducibility details.

## Inputs

Research question, methods, results, authorship facts and requested sections. Prerequisite: Research evidence, target venue guidance and source artifacts.

## Workflow

1. Build a claim-to-evidence map before prose. Separate measured results, literature claims and hypotheses.
2. Describe data selection, procedures, software versions and analysis choices sufficiently to reproduce the study; retain deviations and negative findings.
3. Write results with denominators, units and uncertainty. Keep interpretation and limitations distinct from observation.
4. Check the requested venue’s current format/reporting guidance and citation accuracy; preserve author review responsibilities.

## Verification

Reconcile all tables/figures and numeric statements with source outputs and verify references.

## Limits

Do not invent experiments, ethics approvals, authors, affiliations or statistical significance.

## Español

Redacta desde evidencia real, conserva resultados negativos y revisa cifras, métodos y referencias.
